subject: Bounded audit scope & SOC2/pen-test language — proposed redlines for Acera Health
messages:
From: Ben Adams <ben.adams@acerahealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit rights + SOC2 / pen-test scope for upcoming order form

Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — we’re working through the order form (attached) and legal has flagged the security exhibit / audit rights language. Two asks from our side that we need clarified before we can route to procurement: 

- Can you confirm the scope of the "audit/inspection" right (what systems/data are in/out)? We want to avoid broad on-prem-style inspection language.
- Pen test timing & evidence cadence: we need a clear window and who receives artifacts (reports, mitigations).

High level: Acera expects SOC 2 attestation annually, a formal pen-test report where findings are redacted for PII, and an operations-level evidence handoff for a subset of controls.

Attached: Acera_Request_20260801.pdf (summary of asks).

Ben Adams
Director, Vendor Security
Acera Health
ben.adams@acerahealth.com
[Attachment: Acera_Request_20260801.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Adams <ben.adams@acerahealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit rights + SOC2 / pen-test scope for upcoming order form

Ben — thanks, appreciate the clarity. Looping in Legal (Karthik, Olga) and Contracts (Laura) to propose concrete redlines.

Topline proposal from product/ops: 
- "Bounded inspection" language: limit audit to Redwood-controlled production services and exclude customer-managed networks/endpoints.
- Pen test: provide 30 days' notice for planned tests; up to two test windows per 12 months; Redwood will produce a redacted vendor report and provide a remediation plan within 30 days of report delivery.
- Evidence handoff: provide a SOC 2 attestation and an "evidence matrix" mapping controls to artifacts; operational evidence will be delivered via a secure shared folder on a quarterly rolling basis for in-scope controls.

I attached a first-pass redline and an evidence matrix for your review. If this aligns with Acera’s expectations, propose a 30-minute sync this week to agree final wording.

Attachments: proposed_security_exhibit_redline_20260805.docx, soc2_evidence_matrix_20260805.csv

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
[Attachment: proposed_security_exhibit_redline_20260805.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: soc2_evidence_matrix_20260805.csv (csv)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit rights + SOC2 / pen-test scope for upcoming order form

Adding legal/contract perspective — a few concrete edits I recommend before we send to Acera: 

1) Replace vague "inspection" term with "limited inspection and evidence delivery" and define specific systems (control plane logs, tenant-scoped audit logs, SOC2 attestations). No physical access unless previously agreed and scheduled.

2) Notice period: 10 business days' written notice for any pen test kickoff (shorter than 30 for responsiveness but still operationally safe).

3) Data handling: pen-test reports will be redacted to remove customer PII and shared under an NDA; Redwood retains the right to validate and redact vendor reports for security.

4) Evidence cadence: propose quarterly rolling delivery for control evidence (sample extracts), with one annual bulk submission aligned to SOC 2 report date. Operational evidence delivery should be via a secure ingestion channel or shared folder; do not accept arbitrary pull-based access.

Suggested excerpt to include in redline (copy into the attached doc):

"Redwood shall permit Customer to request a limited inspection of Redwood's services solely to the extent necessary to verify Redwood's compliance with the security obligations set forth in the Agreement. Such inspection shall be scoped to Redwood-managed infrastructure and associated control artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 reports, audit logs) and shall not include Customer-managed networks, endpoints, or developer workstations. Inspection requests require at least ten (10) business days' prior written notice and shall be conducted during mutually agreed windows. Redwood may redact information to protect third-party confidentiality or PII, provided that such redaction does not materially frustrate the purpose of the inspection."

Questions for product/legal alignment: are we comfortable with 10 business days vs 30? Also want to limit to two pen-test windows per year — ops can support that cadence.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: excerpt_redline_snippet.txt (txt)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit rights + SOC2 / pen-test scope for upcoming order form

Quick legal notes — agreed with Laura's direction, plus: 

- SOC 2 frequency: include explicit language that Redwood will maintain an annual SOC 2 Type II attestation and provide a copy within 30 days of request (or earlier if available).
- Pen test scope carveout: exclude customer-controlled data stores and integrations where Acera manages the keys. We can propose a short carveout listing the systems that are out of scope.
- Evidence redaction: clarify that Redwood will redact items that contain customer PII or third-party secrets, and that Redwood will provide a redaction log.

I uploaded a short legal memo to the shared drive with sample redline language and fallback options (link below). If Ops wants more than two windows/year, we should require escalation and formal change order.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal — Contracts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit rights + SOC2 / pen-test scope for upcoming order form — proposed redlines attached

Hi Ben / Marta — thanks for the original note. Per our internal review we attached a proposed security exhibit redline and an evidence matrix that maps Acera's requested controls to concrete artifacts and delivery cadence. Highlights: 

- Defined "limited inspection" scope (Redwood-managed infra only).
- Pen-test windows: default = up to two windows per 12 months; 10 business days' notice required; redacted vendor report + remediation plan within 30 days.
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide annual attestation; operational evidence delivered quarterly as document samples mapped in the attached matrix.

Attachments: proposed_security_exhibit_redline_20260805.docx, soc2_evidence_matrix_20260805.csv

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm (yes/no) on the two carveouts below by end of week: 
   - Exclude Customer-managed key stores and customer-only endpoints from pen-test scope.
   - Accept quarterly rolling evidence + one annual bulk delivery timed to SOC2 report.
2) If confirmed, can we schedule a 30-minute call Thurs/Fri to run legal/ops through the exact redline? I can send calendar invites.

Thanks — happy to iterate.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Enterprise GTM
Redwood Inference
